assumptions.source_scenario: County model v1: Census TIGER 2025 roads; FHWA HPMS 2024 AADT where available (50/50 on divided carriageways), documented functional-class defaults elsewhere.
assumptions.traffic: Evening flow = 0.6 × day, night = 0.2 × day. Not observed or current traffic.
assumptions.method: Direct union export copied as emitted; physically impossible receivers masked, on-road receivers labelled.
assumptions.calibration: Uncalibrated modeled exterior LAeq; not a measurement, interior level, or quietness rating.
